description: This Tessara Complete (HMO) statement for March 2026 has two claims. Claim 1 prints the same physical therapy visit twice, with the same date and code, so the member pays the $25 therapy copay twice. Claim 2 (lab tests) is correct. A careful reviewer should treat the second therapy line as a duplicate and conclude the member owes one copay, not two.

sources.what: An exact duplicate matches another claim line on beneficiary, provider, date of service, procedure code and billed amount
sources.source: CMS, Medicare Claims Processing Manual (Pub. 100-04), ch. 1, §120.2 Exact Duplicates, https://www.cms.gov/regulations-and-guidance/guidance/manuals/downloads/clm104c01.pdf

sources.what: Under the rule that a plan must state its copays, this plan charges one therapy copay per visit (note K1)
sources.source: eCFR, 42 CFR 422.111(b)(2), Disclosure requirements (benefits and cost sharing, such as copayments), https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-42/chapter-IV/subchapter-B/part-422/subpart-C/section-422.111; Medicare.gov, What does Medicare cost?, https://www.medicare.gov/basics/get-started-with-medicare/medicare-basics/what-does-medicare-cost

sources.what: Review each statement for accuracy and compare it with your own calendar of appointments, tests and X-rays
sources.source: Medicare.gov, Protecting Yourself From Fraud (CMS Product No. 10111), https://www.medicare.gov/publications/10111-protecting-yourself-from-fraud.pdf
